title: A1 preview Promotion Decision
description: Immutable candidate decision for one exact Candidate Identity Record. An APPROVE decision admits only one passing pre-decision Stage Gate Evidence set. It does not pre-bind a promotion run, permission readback, mutable remote state, pre-publication evidence, or post-publication proof; each later remote mutation requires a fresh Promotion Attempt.
$comment: Semantic admission resolves candidate_identity_record and evidence.pre_decision_stage_evidence by raw references and SHA-256. DECISION_CANDIDATE_RECORD_EQUALITY requires the embedded candidate to equal the resolved Candidate Identity Record. DECISION_PRE_DECISION_STAGE_EQUALITY requires the stage record to resolve to stage-gate-evidence.schema.json; bind the same candidate record, candidate hash, candidate object, source ref, source commit, and Release Gate Catalog; have stage=pre-decision and outcome=PASS; and contain exactly the four catalog descriptors. Its retained proof, S2/S3 seven-lens aggregate, independent PR review, and candidate exact-head Sonar records must each validate and pass. The aggregate must independently recompute exactly seven required and completed lenses with zero unresolved high severity. A Decision never admits pre-publication or post-publication stage evidence.

promotion_attempt.description: Static authorization template only. It names neither a historical promote run nor a remote proof.

pre_decision_stage_evidence.description: Sealed exact-candidate pre-decision stage evidence. Its raw record validates against stage-gate-evidence.schema.json.
